finding_retest.title: Long convex middle hems are still the inherited r2 shape
finding_retest.actual_output_observation: At180 and225degrees, the main middle rim remains a broad pair of convex hems around one centralV. The r2/r3 native-pixel comparison shows only slight narrowing/edge shifts, not a materially source-matched replacement with unequal straight polygonal plate ends. SourceA24 shows distinctly straighter plate-edge runs and angular corner changes. This is a visible edge-treatment issue; no hidden source notch location is asserted.
finding_retest.targeted_fix: Establish one source-first A61 visible-face tree with the actual uneven plate-end and notch profile, using A52 andA24 only as corroboration. Review that single source face before extending it into an eight-view reconstruction. Preserve the now-correct general crown proportions/material; do not spend another identical whole-sheet edit on vague angularity.

finding_retest.title: Contour and material
finding_retest.actual_output_observation: The thinner restrained edge and broad planar shading fromr2 are retained; no regression requiring a broad style change was found. Original shader identity remains unknown.

finding_retest.title: Excess relative lower flare
finding_retest.actual_output_observation: The lower crown is visibly narrowed while the upper cap and tree height remain. Approximate lower-to-cap width is now1.45 versus about1.48 inA61, within the limits of this manual/perspective-dependent guide.

cross_view_coherence: All eight views retain three tiers, pointed cap, tiny trunk and plausible approximate scale. No conclusive impossible geometry jump is asserted; eight illustrations do not verify a common3Dmesh or exact rotational topology.

edit_series_assessment.reason: R2 materially improved contour/material; R3 materially corrected lower flare. However, the inherited middle-hem geometry survived two focused edits with minimal change. Further near-identical sheet-edit calls have weak evidence of resolving that remaining mismatch.
edit_series_assessment.recommendation: Stop full-sheet repetition and rebuild one visible tree from the original source pixels first. This is a method change for the remaining reference match, not a new species or lowered requirement.
edit_series_assessment.next_review_gate: The single visible-face candidate must match source canopy contours, unequal plate ends/notches, proportions and trunk at>=9.9before eight-view expansion. Full100-percent unseen original geometry remains unverified.
